title: Mac sign-in is never disturbed
description: Across successful use and a rejected refresh token (securetoken 400), session.json keeps identical bytes, mode 0600 and mtime, and tools report 'sign in again' instead of failing silently..
criterion: Across successful use and a rejected refresh token (securetoken 400), session.json keeps identical bytes, mode 0600 and mtime, and tools report 'sign in again' instead of failing silently.
prerequisites: Go 1.27+, Node 20+ (for the web-side checks). No network, no real account: a local fake Firebase is used.
